name: 🌮 Taco Fiesta
tagline: Weeknight turkey tacos with real flavor: a hard sear, a saucy finish, and a build-your-own bar.

items.name: Ortega taco sauce, plus more to serve
Bush's black beans, drained and rinsed
Flour tortillas, for anyone who wants a burrito
Shredded lettuce, sour cream, salsa, avocado, cilantro

steps.text: Set out the taco bar: cheese, lettuce, sour cream, salsa, limes cut in wedges. Warm the oven to 200°F for the tortillas.
Heat the oil in a big skillet over medium-high until it shimmers. Add the turkey, press it flat, and leave it alone for 3–4 minutes so the bottom browns.
Break it into small crumbles and cook until no pink is left, about 3 minutes more.
Stir in the taco seasoning, the water and ¼ cup taco sauce. Simmer until it's saucy and glossy, not soupy.
Stir the black beans into the meat (or warm them in a small pot for anyone who wants them on the side). Squeeze in half a lime and taste.
Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel, then foil, and warm them in the oven 10 minutes (or char each one 15 seconds over a gas flame).
Everyone builds their own. Leftover meat goes in a container for tomorrow's lunch before seconds start.

kid_jobs.job: Set up the taco bar in bowls and put a spoon in each one
Drain and rinse the black beans in a strainer
Cut the limes into wedges (with a grown-up)
Count out tortillas and wrap them for the oven

chef_tip: Don't stir the turkey for the first 3–4 minutes. Lean turkey has little fat, so browning is where all the flavor comes from.
make_ahead: Cook the meat up to 2 days ahead; reheat with a splash of water.
leftovers: Taco bowls for lunch: meat + beans over Minute rice with cheese and salsa.
swaps: Ground beef works the same way
serve_with: Tortilla chips and salsa, or Alexia street corn
gear: Small bowls for the taco bar
heads_up: Oven on to 200°F for the tortillas.

game_plan.what: Oven to 200°F. Kids set out the taco bar and cut limes.
Turkey in the hot skillet; leave it alone to brown.
Crumble it, then seasoning, water and taco sauce.
Tortillas wrapped and into the oven. Kids rinse the beans.
Beans into the meat, squeeze of lime, taste.
Tortillas out, everyone builds their own.
